name: Sandbox
author: Brett
description: A shielded sandbox for anyone signed in to the console: read-only GitHub (through axHub, only read tools, only the repositories an admin opens), Build Pilot's designer steps over the framework catalog (a design is saved only as a sandbox file; nothing is built or published) and private editable files that stay until an admin clears them. Nothing outside the sandbox can be changed. Linked under Settings → Account & security → Your account; managed in Settings → Plugins → Sandbox.
